entry.title: `return (T *)p;` is read as returning no place, so an acquisition returned through a cast is reported as a leak; dlopen/dlclose withheld on it
entry.why: Measured by card W43-DESCRIPTOR-RESOURCE-TRACKING: the return route escapes `return p;` but answers a parenthesised cast of one place with no returned place, so the site stays live and `report_leaks` reports it at that exit, for the heap exactly as for a stream (`descriptor_custody.rs::a_cast_return_is_not_an_escape_for_any_kind`). Three of the 271 combined-tree leak leaves already sit at such an exit (`mk_string_copy_substr` 1, `rd_kafka_anyconf_dump` 2; scripts/cast_return_leaks.py). The card's first AFTER run declared dlopen/dlclose and moved `rd_dl_open0` Unknown -> provisional Unsafe with one leak at `return (rd_dl_hnd_t *)handle;` — a candidate refuted by reading, since the handle is returned. The pair and the `dynamic_library` kind were withdrawn before the published arbiter; they hold 5 leaves in 4 functions (`mk_plugin_load_dynamic`, `rd_dl_open0`, `mk_plugin_load`, `rd_dl_close`), dlopen and dlclose sole-blocking one function each. Discharge condition: the return route escapes the place under a pointer-to-pointer cast (the value is unchanged, C11 6.3.2.3p7) with Lean parity and an arbiter attributing every withdrawn leak, then the dlopen/dlclose declarations re-measured.

ground: Its discharge condition is "the return route escapes the place under a pointer-to-pointer cast (the value is unchanged, C11 6.3.2.3p7) with Lean parity and an arbiter attributing every withdrawn leak, then the dlopen/dlclose declarations re-measured". Card W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT decides `return ( T * ) PLACE ;` (a chain of pointer casts included) exactly as `return PLACE ;` for an operand that is neither a declared scalar nor a possible descriptor, keeps `(int) fd` of a possible descriptor as custody, and refuses every other cast of a possible descriptor and every integer cast of a declared pointer (crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_cast_return.rs; QCore.CastReturnEscape, 12 audited theorems; crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/leak_pin_audit.rs). The arbiter withdrew the one leak its audit attributes to the shape (mk_string_copy_substr, mk_string.c:665); the two rd_kafka_anyconf_dump leaves the entry counted at a cast return are refused stores of `val` into `arr`, withdrawn by the card's refused hand-on rule. The re-declaration half is rehomed to W44-DLOPEN-DECLARATION-REMEASURE, because it needs the library-handle kind W43 withdrew. docs/reports/w44-leak-pin-audit/README.md.
